title: Austin Leaders' New Vision, Cactus Pryor Hosts
summary:
*   Austin's Mayor and city officials, joined by a State Senator and County Judge, held an informal "City Council in Concert" news conference.
*   The focus of the meeting was for these leaders to outline their goals, priorities, and visions for the upcoming year.
*   The special event featured local personality Cactus Pryor serving as Master of Ceremonies.
transcript:

Mayor Cooke called to order the special called meeting of the Council, noting the absence
of Councilmember Carl-Mitchell.
Mayor Cooke announced the purpose of the meeting was an informal news conference, "City
Council in Concert".
Mayor Cooke, members of the Austin City Council, State Senator Gonzalo Barrientos, Maline
McCalla, co-chair of the Austin ISO Commission, and Judge Bill Aleshire, Travis County
Commissioners Court, outlined their goals, priorities and visions for the New Year.
Cactus Pryor served as Master of Ceremonies.
The meeting was adjourned at 7:20 P.M.
